overview.text: A powerful Thanksgiving storm hit the East Coast, leaving hundreds of thousands without power; restoration is under way as rain eases.
U.S. forces disabled a commercial ship that allegedly tried to breach the Iran blockade, according to Central Command.
Bipartisan lawmakers urge Trump to rescind Putin's invitation to next month's G20 summit in Florida over alleged intelligence-sharing with Iran.
Canada's top court largely upheld Quebec's ban on religious symbols for public sector workers.
An explosion near a school in Afghanistan killed at least seven students and injured nearly 100, officials say.
The Spurs rallied from 20 down to beat the Lakers 99-96 and reach the NBA Cup knockout round.

stories.headline: Spurs erase 20-point deficit to beat Lakers, reach NBA Cup knockouts
stories.summary: San Antonio rallied to beat Los Angeles 99-96 and advance to the NBA Cup knockout round as a wild card.
stories.why: The comeback keeps the Spurs' Cup run alive.

stories.headline: UTSA beats Tulsa, earns home field for American title game
stories.summary: UTSA took down Tulsa to clinch home-field advantage in the American Conference championship game.

stories.headline: Truck crashes into San Antonio dog daycare on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: A truck crashed into a San Antonio dog daycare on Thanksgiving, and one dog is still missing.

stories.headline: Thanksgiving storm batters East Coast, knocking out power to nearly 1 million
stories.summary: A powerful storm flooded streets and downed trees and power lines from New York to Virginia. Skies cleared Friday and power is slowly being restored to hundreds of thousands of customers.
stories.why: Outages and flooding disrupted holiday plans and travel across a large part of the country.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over alleged trade secret theft
stories.summary: OpenAI accuses Apple of stealing trade secrets and discouraging hardware suppliers from working on future OpenAI devices. It follows Apple's suit accusing OpenAI of poaching employees.
stories.why: The dispute between two major tech firms could shape the AI device market.

stories.headline: Postponed Macy's 100th Thanksgiving Day parade gets a do-over with 100 balloons and 1,000 clowns
stories.summary: Macy's 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade is taking place a few days later than the holiday after being postponed due to bad weather

stories.headline: Two million children have lost food stamp benefits
stories.summary: Cuts in the Republican domestic policy bill were meant to root out fraud and push adults to work. The New York Times reports two million children have lost benefits.
stories.why: The cuts directly affect household food budgets for millions of families.

stories.headline: U.S. forces disable ship allegedly trying to breach Iran blockade
stories.summary: A U.S. military aircraft struck a Palau-flagged commercial ship with precision munitions after multiple warnings, Central Command said.
stories.why: It shows the U.S. enforcing its blockade of Iran with force.

stories.headline: Lawmakers urge Trump to disinvite Putin from G20 summit
stories.summary: A bipartisan group wants Trump to rescind Vladimir Putin's invitation to next month's G20 in Florida over alleged intelligence-sharing with Iran.

stories.headline: Canada's top court upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols
stories.summary: The Supreme Court largely upheld a Quebec secularism law barring public sector workers from wearing conspicuous religious symbols, in a closely watched ruling.
stories.why: The ruling tests the balance between minority rights and government power.

stories.headline: Seven students killed, nearly 100 injured in Afghanistan blast
stories.summary: An Afghan interior ministry spokesman says the explosion was caused by carelessness at a nearby explosives depot. Officials say casualty figures are preliminary.

stories.headline: Kenyan cult leader convicted over 123 more deaths
stories.summary: Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of killing 123 followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.

stories.headline: The M5 MacBook Air just got its biggest discount since Apple raised the price
stories.summary: If you’ve been holding off on buying a new MacBook Air since Apple raised prices by $200 in June, you’re in luck.

stories.headline: Pensions and benefits services still down after 'cyber incident'
stories.summary: The UK's former chief technology officer says the Department for Work and Pensions may have been hit by hackers, but the government has not confirmed that.

stories.headline: Intel faced a choice: Give Trump 10% or face the consequences
stories.summary: Intel faced pressure to surrender a 10% stake to unlock billions in promised grants.

stories.headline: Hundreds of thousands still without power a day after US slammed with Thanksgiving storms

stories.headline: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
stories.summary: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.

stories.headline: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
stories.summary: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

stories.headline: A.I. Companies Race for Space in New York, a City That Doesn’t Have Much of It
stories.summary: The artificial intelligence boom is on track to help lift Manhattan’s office market to its strongest year since 2000. But as the market tightens, A.I. companies have had to get creative for real estate.

stories.headline: It’s Boom Times for Old TV Shows. New TV, Not So Much.
stories.summary: Fewer original series, decision fatigue and a desire for comfort have viewers escaping to the past.

stories.headline: From £250 job to £9,000 bill: Inside the rogue trader networks scamming customers at scale
stories.summary: Networks of plumbers and electricians are scamming people on a large scale, the BBC reveals.

stories.headline: Fan shoves Luka Dončić after he flings his wristband at a woman in crowd
stories.summary: This is not a good look for Luka, regardless of his innocent explanation

stories.headline: Mark Pope buyout, contract details: How much it would cost Kentucky to fire coach after loss to Wichita State
stories.summary: Mark Pope is not looking for anyone else to blame after Kentucky’s embarrassing overtime defeat to Wichita State.

stories.headline: Lille predicted XI v Le Mans: Davide Ancelotti to make two changes to side that beat Bayern Munich

stories.headline: Contrary to popular belief, foot traffic and spending at malls is up
stories.summary: This is the biggest shopping weekend for the American mall, which — despite widespread belief to the contrary — is not dying. One reason? Teens and tweens have rediscovered the hangout.

stories.headline: Carly Rae Jepsen's viral hit proves what fans knew all along
stories.summary: The Call Me Maybe star returns to the UK Top 40 as her single Run Away With Me gets a GTA VI boost.

stories.headline: ‘Focker In-Law’ Reunites Skyler Gisondo, Beanie Feldstein and Eduardo Franco
stories.summary: Skyler Gisondo, Beanie Feldstein and Eduardo Franco had breakout roles in the 2019 high-school comedy. Now, they’re reuniting for “Focker In-Law.”
